Terms of use

The terms that apply when you use the Netprox website.

Using this site

This website gives information about Netprox courses and programmes. By using it you agree to these terms.

Course information

We keep course details, durations and schedules accurate, but they may change. Fees and start dates are confirmed by an adviser before you enrol. Cisco certification exam vouchers are paid separately from course fees.

National diplomas

OND and HND programmes are awarded by Bellarks Polytechnic and are subject to final NBTE approval of the Lakowe study centre arrangement. Registering interest is not an offer of admission.

Trademarks

Cisco and Cisco Networking Academy are trademarks of Cisco Systems, Inc. Exam names belong to their awarding bodies. Netprox and the Netprox logo belong to Netprox Limited.

Links

We link to WhatsApp, Google Maps and other services. Their own terms apply when you use them.

Contact
